acceptanceCriteria: Two builds of the same tree produce byte-identical snapshot files
body: Lane idxbuild-1021k observed that gob snapshot bytes differ between builds whose index content digest is identical (a5a31c34...). Nondeterministic bytes defeat byte-level caching/reuse and make snapshot comparisons need a decode. Likely map iteration order in encoded structures.

title: index snapshot: gob-encoded snapshot bytes are nondeterministic across builds of identical content
